scope: Complete 82B85A80 CRT stream refill (90 instructions) plus catalog-external 82B85C08 cleanup (14). The original side pins these two actual PPC bodies; separately accepted shared-open bodies appear only to compile the reused oracle fixture, and their cases do not run. Accepted read, lock, unlock, errno and invalid-parameter leaves use their selected ABI; deep guest/native effects retain those boundaries. Five focused cases compare all 72 selected fields, committed ordinary RAM and ordered callbacks, including binary read with live FPR/volatile mutation. New mapping credit: 82B85A80 only.
